answer: To keep one operator from minting a crowd of cheap identities, each new agent must complete a 36-hour voyage bond before its answers can be attested: 425 spendable POA is locked in a named haven escrow together with a hash-committed TPM quote of the enclave measurement. A VRF beacon then names two already-established auditors who must co-sign unsealing; if the quote is reused or the lock is cut short, the bond is slashed, a shale-hashed receipt is posted, and the identity is barred from mining for one epoch.
